subject: Action: Sprint audit – flag & reclassify at-risk opportunities for Q4 predictability
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ashwin Patel <ashwin.patel@biocorp.com>
Date: 2028-08-30T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Action: Sprint audit – flag & reclassify at-risk opportunities for Q4 predictability

Team / Ashwin —

Quick one: finance ran a small predictability audit and flagged a set of Q4 opportunities where stage and close-date metadata don’t match recent customer engagement. BI0C-8472 (Biocorp) is on the list and reads as a committed deal in SFDC but our activity/timeline doesn't support a Q4 close without confirmation.

Please take these actions by end of day Mon 2028-08-31 so we can lock Q4 guidance:
- Lauren: pull the most recent evidence (emails, signed LOIs, PO timelines) and attach a single archive.
- Monica: validate the SFDC stage history and ensure the close date reflects the next contractual milestone.
- Ashwin: confirm Biocorp's go/no-go date or provide the next definitive milestone (PO submission, procurement window, legal signoff).

If we don't get confirmation by EOD 8/31 we'll follow the hygiene playbook: mark as "At Risk / No Decision" and adjust commit accordingly for forecasting. I know this is tight — happy to hop on a 15-min sync if that helps.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment requested: SFDC opportunity snapshot, recent customer correspondence]

From: Ashwin Patel <ashwin.patel@biocorp.com>

Subject: Re: Action: Sprint audit – flag & reclassify at-risk opportunities for Q4 predictability

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the heads up.

We're still finalizing internal procurement windows; legal has a review scheduled for the week of Sep 10 and procurement expects to issue a PO late-September at the earliest. I don't have a firm PO date today.

Can we do a 15-min sync today at 11:30 PT to walk through what you need as evidence? If not, I'll ask procurement to provide a one-paragraph timeline note for your audit.

— Ashwin
Ashwin Patel
Head of IT Procurement, Biocorp Therapeutics

Jonas / Ashwin —

I've pulled the last 90 days of activity and attached a packet: sfdc-opps-export-BI0C-8472.csv and Q4-risk-evidence.zip. Highlights:
- Last substantive customer email on record: 2028-07-12 (request for contract template).
- Legal review request logged on 2028-08-22 but no confirmation of completion.
- No PO or initial payment scheduled in SFDC activities.

Recommended hygiene actions if we don't get a customer-confirmed milestone by EOD 8/31:
1) Move BI0C-8472 to Stage = "At Risk / No Decision"
2) Set Close Date to 2028-12-31 (forecast placeholder)
3) Add a task for CS to re-engage and require a one-paragraph procurement timeline as evidence before reinstating commit

Attachment stubs:
- Q4-risk-evidence.zip (contains exported email thread pdfs, contract draft v3, and calendar screenshots)
- sfdc-opps-export-BI0C-8472.csv

If Ashwin can either confirm a specific milestone or grant a short procurement note, we can keep the deal in commit for Q4. Otherwise we'll reclass per the steps above.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks all —

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Lauren. Ashwin, thanks for the context; 11:30 PT works for me — I'll take that and invite Monica too.

Plan for follow-up after the sync:
- If Biocorp confirms a procurement milestone within the next 24 hours, Lauren will update SFDC stage/close date and reattach the evidence.
- If not, Monica please proceed to update stage to "At Risk / No Decision" and move close date to 2028-12-31 as a placeholder for forecasting. Finance will be informed and the commit will be adjusted in the Q4 rollup.

I'll log the playbook action in the opportunity record and add the evidence bundle link.

Best,
Jonas
